note: EXAMPLE shelf, not real data: the 41 AGORA shapes with what each stands for. No numbers of yours are shown here.

shapes.name: Doric column
shapes.means: Strength and discipline. The plain, sturdy column: one simple rule that holds the whole roof up.

shapes.name: Ionic column
shapes.means: Learning and balance. The scrolled column: a plan that is both strong and graceful.

shapes.name: Temple
shapes.means: A place of trust. Every part of the system standing together under one roof.

shapes.name: Obelisk
shapes.means: Permanence. A record carved to last: the long, honest track record.

shapes.name: Stele with inscription
shapes.means: A promise in stone. An inscribed slab: the rules you wrote down and agreed to keep.

shapes.name: Stoa
shapes.means: Shelter for the whole group. The covered walk where people meet and talk it over.

shapes.name: Fountain
shapes.means: Steady flow. Income that keeps running, tier by tier.

shapes.name: Mosaic floor tile
shapes.means: Many small pieces, one picture. Each trade is a tile; the pattern shows over time.

shapes.name: Sundial
shapes.means: Timing. Reading the session by the light of day: when to trade and when to wait.

shapes.name: Hourglass
shapes.means: Time running. The eval clock and the trading day: sand falls, patience pays.

shapes.name: Scroll
shapes.means: The written plan. Rules and records kept on paper so nothing is left to memory.

shapes.name: Red-figure krater
shapes.means: Craft and story. A vase painted with scenes: a journal is the story of your trades.

shapes.name: Kylix cup
shapes.means: Celebration, shared. A wine cup raised after a goal is reached; enjoy it, then get back to the plan.

shapes.name: Brazier
shapes.means: Hestia's fire. The steady daily routine that keeps the home warm.

shapes.name: Lyre of Apollo
shapes.means: Harmony. Many strings in tune: entries, stops and targets playing one plan.

shapes.name: Harp
shapes.means: Calm focus. A harp played slowly: patience between setups.

shapes.name: Hoplon shield
shapes.means: Defence. Protecting the account: the drawdown limit that is never crossed.

shapes.name: Corinthian helmet
shapes.means: Readiness. Focus put on before the open: calm, covered, ready.

shapes.name: Laurel wreath
shapes.means: Victory. A goal reached: a passed eval, a good week.

shapes.name: Bust on a plinth
shapes.means: The person behind the plan. A marble portrait: you, calm and in command of the trades.

shapes.name: Caduceus
shapes.means: Safe passage and fair deals. Hermes' staff: messages and trades delivered without loss.

shapes.name: Winged sandal
shapes.means: Swiftness. Hermes' sandals: act fast when the signal is clear, stand still when it is not.

shapes.name: Bow and quiver
shapes.means: Aim before you release. Choose the target first, then take one clean shot.

shapes.name: Sword and spear
shapes.means: Tools of the trade, kept sharp. Entry and exit crossed, each ready when needed.

shapes.name: Olive tree
shapes.means: Peace and patience. A tree that grows slowly and feeds a family for generations: steady growth.

shapes.name: Chariot
shapes.means: Speed under control. A fast ride that only works with a firm hand on the reins: sizing the risk.

shapes.name: Athena's owl
shapes.means: Wisdom. Look carefully, then act: analysis before every decision.

shapes.name: Pegasus
shapes.means: Rising ambition. The winged horse: big goals, carried by a sound plan.

shapes.name: Dolphin
shapes.means: Good luck at sea. A leaping dolphin: a friendly sign that the trade is going with the tide.

shapes.name: Coin stacks
shapes.means: Capital. The money itself, built coin by coin and counted in dollars.

shapes.name: Scales
shapes.means: Risk against reward. Every R weighed next to its dollars.

shapes.name: Pillar chart
shapes.means: Results at a glance. A bar chart built as pillars: taller means more.

shapes.name: Tetradrachm coin
shapes.means: Money and wisdom on one face. Athens' silver coin with the owl, spinning.

shapes.name: Gold bars
shapes.means: Banked gains. Profit locked away at the target, not left to chance.

shapes.name: Vault door
shapes.means: Safekeeping. The vault: payouts moved out of the account and into your hands.

shapes.name: Amphora
shapes.means: Savings. A store of value kept safe for later: payouts put away.

shapes.name: Cornucopia
shapes.means: Abundance. The horn of plenty: what steady work and good habits bring back.

shapes.name: Trophy cup
shapes.means: A prize earned. The passed eval and the payouts: proof the plan worked.

shapes.name: Trireme
shapes.means: Reach and trade. Capital sailing out to markets and coming home.

shapes.name: Anchor
shapes.means: Staying put. The anchor holds in a storm: your stop, and the discipline to leave it alone.

shapes.name: Lighthouse of Pharos
shapes.means: Guidance in the dark. A steady light to steer by: the levels the bot watches.
